_meta.description: ILM for agent-monitors-projector-health-* (monthly index agent-monitors-projector-health-YYYY-MM; FRE-557 / ADR-0088 D6 live-projector bus-delivery health, one doc per trace at turn completion). min_age-based delete from origination date (no rollover write-alias). Authored in FRE-1036; this family previously had no ILM policy at all (indices accreted forever).
